question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They were watching a movie on TV when their friends came.

options.text: A movie on TV was watching by them when their friends came.
A movie on TV was being watched by them when their friends came.
When their friends came, a movie on TV was watched by them.
A movie on TV is being watched by them when their friend came.

solution:
The correct answer is:** A movie on TV was being watched by them when their friends came**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Given the sentence is 

 
• They were watching a movie on TV when their friends came.
 
• The above sentence contains past continuous tense.
 
• So the rule for converting active to passive voice: **object+was/were+being+third form of do verb+by +object.**
 
• Here **They** are the **subject** and **watching **is the **do verb **and **a movie on TV when their friends came** is an **object**.

Hence the** passive voice** is: A movie on TV was being watched by them when their friends came. So **option(2) **is correct.
